fold_assignment_method: MILP minimizes maximum fold eligible-residue deviation, then a deterministic steepest-descent repair over whole-H-group moves (equal-size swaps; size-2 vs two size-1; size-3 vs 2+1 or three size-1) minimizes SSE, H-group-count range, then hash tie-break.

solver.repair: steepest-descent over equal-size swaps, size-2 vs two size-1, and size-3 vs 2+1 or three size-1
